text:
Predicates:
Flies(x, y) ::: x flies to y.
Airport(y) ::: y is an airport.
Premises:
Susan Flies to LGA ::: Flies(Susan, LGA)
The departure and arrival cannot be the same airport ::: ∀x ∀y (Flies(x, y) → y ≠ y) [which is always false, but in the context, indicates departure ≠ arrival]
John flies from LGA ::: Flies(John, LGA)
Conclusion:
Flies(John, LGA) ::: John flies to LGA
